name: tefas-js
description: Unofficial, dependency-free TEFAS client for fund prices, listings, daily data, asset allocation, return comparisons and fund types in JavaScript and TypeScript.
author: abaciarda

scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:node
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test:node && bun run test:bun
scripts.verify:package: bun run check && bun run build:scripts && node .script-build/verify-package.js
scripts.smoke:live: bun run build && bun run build:scripts && node .script-build/live-smoke.js
scripts.discover: bun run build && bun run build:scripts && node .script-build/discover.js
